+Studio opens in **Luồng chính** (business flow) with readable node sizes. **Chỉ màn hình** contracts intermediate steps into screen links; **Tất cả node** restores the original graph. The visible/total count makes filtering explicit. Select a node and choose **Xem liên kết gần** to inspect its two-hop neighborhood, or expand the canvas by hiding the project sidebar. Sizes survive view changes in the current Studio session; **Sắp xếp lại** reflows using those sizes. Position/size changes do not modify Dart source and reset when Studio is reloaded. The minimap hides during node selection to leave resize handles accessible.
+
+Screen cards show their route and router; the inspector lists all discovered aliases and parameters. Nested literal GoRouter paths and named Material routes are recognized. An unresolved route is shown as unknown rather than invented. Connection arrowheads, labels, colors and patterns distinguish entry, call, return, sequence, navigation, branch and state links. Choose curved, orthogonal or straight connectors. Incoming/outgoing links in the inspector jump directly to related nodes. Collapsed links retain their underlying edge IDs for runtime highlighting without increasing confirmed coverage.

Older snapshots still open, converting legacy logout/overlay kinds; snapshots containing only snippets ask for a new CLI scan to obtain full source. Full source is included in graph exports, so review it for hardcoded secrets before sharing.
